## Latest NDBC Observations

Fetch NDBC's network-wide latest-observations text file once. Optional named station_id defaults to an empty string (all stations). Returns observation time in UTC, location, wind speed and gusts in m/s, wave_height_m, dominant_period_s, average_period_s, directions in degrees from true north, temperatures in Celsius and pressure_hpa. visibility_m is converted from nautical miles; water_level_m from feet relative to MLLW. Missing MM values become NULL; zero remains zero. Latest does not guarantee freshness: inspect time separately from fetched_at. NULL station_id is rejected; an unknown but valid ID produces no rows. No API key needed.

### Result columns

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| station_id | NDBC station ID in lowercase; retain as text, including leading zeroes. |
| time | UTC observation timestamp supplied by NDBC; measurements may be stale. |
| latitude | Observation latitude in decimal degrees; NULL when absent from a station history file. |
| longitude | Observation longitude in decimal degrees; NULL when absent from a station history file. |
| wind_direction_deg | Direction wind comes from, clockwise degrees from true north. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| wind_speed_mps | Measured wind speed in metres per second, at the station's anemometer height. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| wind_gust_mps | Wind gust speed in metres per second. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| wave_height_m | Significant wave height in metres; mean of the highest third of sampled waves. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| dominant_period_s | Dominant wave period in seconds, at maximum wave energy. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| average_period_s | Average wave period in seconds. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| wave_direction_deg | Direction waves at the dominant period come from, degrees from true north. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| pressure_hpa | Sea-level atmospheric pressure in hectopascals. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| pressure_tendency_hpa | Signed pressure change over the preceding three hours, in hectopascals. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| air_temperature_c | Air temperature in degrees Celsius. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| water_temperature_c | Water temperature in degrees Celsius. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| dew_point_c | Dew point in degrees Celsius. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| visibility_m | Visibility in metres, converted from source nautical miles. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| water_level_m | Water level in metres relative to MLLW, converted from source feet. Missing MM becomes NULL. |
| source_url | Exact NOAA NDBC source URL. |
| fetched_at | UTC retrieval time; use time to assess measurement freshness. |

Read the recent standard meteorological history for a buoy or land station

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Read one station's recent standard meteorological file (approximately 45 days, coverage varies). Required station_id is case-insensitive. Named start_time/end_time are optional inclusive UTC ISO bounds ending in Z; defaults are empty strings. These filter the downloaded file and do not retrieve archives. Uses the same measurement units and columns as latest_observations(): UTC time, m/s winds, metre waves, second wave periods, Celsius temperatures, hPa pressure, visibility_m and water_level_m (MLLW). Handles separate hour/minute and drifting-station hhmm layouts by header name. Fixed-station files omit coordinates; join stations() by station_id if needed. Missing measurements are NULL, not zero. NULL arguments, malformed rows and unexpected units fail explicitly. HTTP 404 means no file is available. No API key required.

## Recent NDBC Station History

Named start_time/end_time are optional inclusive UTC ISO bounds ending in Z; defaults are empty strings. These filter the downloaded file and do not retrieve archives. Uses the same measurement units and columns as latest_observations(): UTC time, m/s winds, metre waves, second wave periods, Celsius temperatures, hPa pressure, visibility_m and water_level_m (MLLW). Discover active NDBC stations, coordinates, ownership and instrument capabilities

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Read the NDBC active-station XML catalog, including partner and land stations. No arguments or API key. Returns station_id, name, coordinates, elevation_m, owner, program, station_type and capability booleans, plus source_url and fetched_at. IDs are lowercase strings. Missing attributes are NULL. Active station metadata does not guarantee fresh measurements or a standard meteorological file. Filter for has_met and join station_id with observations() or latest_observations(). Coordinates here describe the catalog location, not a moving buoy's observation position.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
## NDBC Active Stations

Read the NDBC active-station XML catalog, including partner and land stations. No arguments or API key. Returns station_id, name, coordinates, elevation_m, owner, program, station_type and capability booleans, plus source_url and fetched_at. IDs are lowercase strings. Missing attributes are NULL. Active station metadata does not guarantee fresh measurements or a standard meteorological file. Filter for has_met and join station_id with observations() or latest_observations(). Coordinates here describe the catalog location, not a moving buoy's observation position.

### Result columns

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| station_id | NDBC station identifier in lowercase. |
| name | Station name. |
| latitude | Station latitude in decimal degrees. |
| longitude | Station longitude in decimal degrees. |
| elevation_m | Site elevation in metres above mean sea level when supplied. |
| owner | Organization responsible for the station. |
| program | NDBC or partner program. |
| station_type | NOAA station type, such as buoy, fixed or oilrig. |
| has_met | Whether NDBC lists meteorological observations for this station. |
| has_currents | Whether NDBC lists current observations; this worker reads standard meteorological data only. |
| has_water_quality | Whether NDBC lists water-quality observations. |
| has_dart | Whether this is a DART tsunami station. |
| source_url | Exact NOAA NDBC source URL. |
| fetched_at | UTC retrieval time; use time to assess measurement freshness. |
